paper_title: Search for Axionlike-Particle-Induced Prompt Gamma-Ray Emission from Extragalactic Core-Collapse Supernovae with the Fermi Large Area Telescope
notes: Median observed combined 95% CL upper limit (solid blue line) from Fig. 2, extracted from the vector paths of the e-print figure combined_limits_Mprog10_SN-Ib-mid-nest_default_jansson12.pdf. Baseline scenario: 10 Msun progenitors, NiCo optical light-curve model, Jansson & Farrar 2012 Galactic magnetic field; limit valid under the assumption that at least one SN was in the LAT field of view (probability 88.5%). Flat level 2.63e-11 GeV^-1 at low mass matches the quoted headline value 2.6e-11 GeV^-1 for ma < 3e-10 eV. Curve rises above the plotted range beyond ~4.6e-9 eV. Astrophysical (non-DM) bound, no density rescaling.
